policy: The app must show today's games and next draw at a glance.
Variable sports/horse schedules must never be guessed; refresh from SELAE event data.
Annual extraordinary draw times must be refreshed from that year's official announcement.
Draw time and sales cutoff are distinct fields and must not be conflated.
